method: layout-bench.mjs in Node 22: seeded 7-layer graph, 1-2 edges per node to the next layer, rankdir top-to-bottom, nodesep 12, ranksep 40. Layout time only. Same machine for both libraries; compare relative, not absolute.

layer_pinning.dagre: No public API: node rank is computed and overwritten; orphan nodes float to rank 0.
layer_pinning.elk: elk.partitioning.activate + elk.partitioning.partition per node. Requires elk.separateConnectedComponents=false, otherwise disconnected parts are laid out separately and pins are ignored.
